_why: DECLARED, NOT ACCEPTED. Each row is a (screen, role, route) triple where a holder of that
role can open that screen and a GET it needs refuses - so the page renders empty.
This file exists so the GATE can be switched on today. Nineteen of these were found by the
first run of screen-route-permission-fit.py, and every one is a decision the OWNER has to
make: some are routes gated on the wrong permission and want widening, and some are correct
refusals that want DECLARING on screen. Neither is a thing to choose on her behalf, and a
gate that went red on all nineteen would be a permanently red build nobody reads - the
MISSING_DESCRIPTION_BUDGET lesson, applied one more time.
IT IS A SET AND NOT A COUNT, deliberately: a count survives a substitution, so nineteen
could become nineteen different mismatches and the gate would stay quiet. The check fails on
any triple absent from this list AND on any triple here that no longer occurs, so the list
cannot rot and cannot be used as a ceiling.
REMOVE a row when the mismatch is fixed. Never ADD one without the owner's decision.
